fact: On 26 May 2026 SIN, the wholly state-owned operator of the Lomé Data Centre, and ST Digital signed a partnership for a private cloud service catalogue at the centre, to keep data hosted on national territory; the text states no policy obliging public bodies to use it.
title: La SIN et ST DIGITAL signent un partenariat stratégique pour une offre de services de cloud privé au Lomé Data Centre
